schema_documentation.purpose: Non-destructive resolution record for the historical Track C protocol artifact-hash drift in the batch_01a_portable and batch_02a_portable packets.
schema_documentation.canonical_seal: resolution_sha256 is sha256: plus SHA-256 over UTF-8 JSON serialized with sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=false after deleting only resolution_sha256.
schema_documentation.packet_record_contract: Each affected_packets entry binds one ledger ID to its repository-relative packet path, exact file digest, canonical packet payload digest, historical protocol digest, current same-path protocol digest, execution presence, and independently reviewed fourth-review disposition.
schema_documentation.reference_contract: Every repository_source_refs path is repository-relative and its sha256 is the digest of the current exact file bytes. The recovered historical protocol bytes are embedded as base64 and are validated after decoding, rather than being written over the current protocol or any historical packet.

verdict.release_meaning: The historical protocol bytes were recovered exactly and the semantic delta was independently assessed. The 31 rows may proceed to pane5 only through this correction record plus the current protocol and fourth review; the historical packet path bindings remain intentionally stale and must not be represented as current-path hash matches.

byte_recovery.recovery_note: The three fields are mirrors of one tool output, not three independent historical copies. The embedded base64 below is the stdout field decoded as UTF-8 bytes; decoding and hashing it reproduces target_sha256.
byte_recovery.durability: The exact historical bytes are now carried inside this allowed correction JSON. No historical packet or protocol file was overwritten.

o_p_relation.evidence: The current protocol retained the same implication taxonomy and false-is-not-exact rule. Fourth review independently recomputed O/P for all 31 affected rows and rejected two prior proxy relations for source/representation reasons. These corrections must survive pane5; they are not execution-derived exactness upgrades.

execution_truth.evidence: The protocol diff changes no oracle algorithm, request, typed input, backend, receipt, artifact bytes or Boolean semantics. All 11 executed defective receipts are COMPLETED_BOOLEAN=false with portable --repo-root . commands and proposal timestamps before started_at; 20 rejected rows have no fabricated receipt.

positive_controls.evidence: All 11 active positive controls remain independently hash-bound, provenance-bearing and COMPLETED_BOOLEAN=true. The protocol delta adds only a method-effectiveness limitation; it does not alter any control artifact or Boolean result. Controls remain binding/error checks, never proof of equivalence.

replay.evidence: All 11 defective and 11 active-control replay audits have overall_match=true and equal normalized projection hashes. The protocol byte drift does not enter replay projection computation.

transitive_protocol_provenance.evidence: The exact 3762 bytes are recovered, embedded and hash-verifiable, closing content availability and enabling a real diff. The 31 immutable packet entries still bind the current repository path to 3762 while that path now contains 6d91; therefore direct clean-checkout path/hash validation of those historical refs still fails by design. This correction bridges the evidence without rewriting history.

Treat the embedded 3762 bytes as recovered historical content and 6d91 as the current protocol; do not claim byte identity.
Verify active A/B/C opinion hashes plus normalized-obligation and property-proposal hashes against the active row before arbitration.

Use source/current-protocol/fourth-review evidence to arbitrate and preserve all semantic conflicts, including EIS-0007-01 and VU-0009-01 as UNSUPPORTED_EXACT/UNRELATED unless stronger source evidence is added.
Record that the historical same-path artifact reference remains stale instead of rewriting any packet, review, receipt or protocol.
limitations: The recovered source is an external Codex session artifact. Durability is supplied by embedding the exact bytes in this correction JSON, but the external session itself is not a repository artifact.
One broad backup traversal failed because /tmp/fuse disappeared. Git-object, repository/worktree/.omx targeted scans and the successful exact session recovery make that failure non-blocking.
This record closes recoverability and impact assessment, not the immutable current-path mismatch inside the 31 historical packets.
